newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish stocks seen to continue uptrend.
newsitem.headline: Turkish stocks seen to continue uptrend.

text.p: 0650 GMT - Turkish stocks are expected to continue its uptrend on Monday as prime minister-designate Mesut Yilmaz intensifies efforts to form a government.
* The IMKB National-100 closed at 1,815 on Friday, 110 points, or 6.45 percent higher from Thursday's close.
*Recent resignations from the ruling parties boost hopes that Yilmaz would win confidence vote in his left-right government.
*Analysts say the index might face resistance at 1,850 and support at 1,800 levels.
